task: Verify the inventory list performance fix: GET /inventory now ships a small server-generated thumb_image instead of the full base64 item_image (list limit raised 500->2500), thumbnails are auto-generated at create time (Pillow, 160px long-edge JPEG q80), a background backfill fills thumb_image for legacy rows missing one, and the frontend (Inventory/Finds/Home/QuickFind/Lightbox) consumes thumb_image with a fallback to item_image, while detail routes (GET /inventory/{id}) still return the full-resolution item_image.
summary: Derived the acceptance matrix myself from the uncommitted working-tree diff (backend/routers/inventory.py, backend/models/appraisal.py, backend/lib/thumbs.py, backend/lib/thumbs_backfill.py, backend/server.py, and the frontend Inventory/Finds/Home/QuickFind consumers) since the briefing text was truncated mid-delivery. Covered 5 criteria with 2 backend test files + 3 browser checks (one run against the public preview URL). All passed. Ran the full backend regression suite (97/103 passed) -- the 6 pre-existing failures are unrelated to this change: 1 is the already-documented out-of-scope Chiswick needs_zone_review seed-flag mismatch (explicitly called out as out of scope in the briefing), and 5 are 'Event loop is closed' failures from xdist worker/motor-connection pollution across ai_quota and appraise/real-Gemini tests when run in the full parallel suite (test_tscheck_shops_seeded_data and test_tscheck_ai_quota_indexes pass individually when isolated, confirming test-infra flakiness, not an app regression caused by the thumbnail fix). No application code was touched by me.
action_items: Pre-existing, out-of-scope: test_tscheck_shops_seeded_data.py::test_shops_seeded_with_14_known_branches fails on `needs_zone_review` for Chiswick High Road (expected True, got False) -- this is the known Chiswick seed-flag issue the briefing explicitly marks out of scope for this task. No action taken.

Pre-existing test-infra flakiness (not an app bug): test_tscheck_ai_quota_daily.py, test_tscheck_ai_quota_daily_rollback_burst.py, test_tscheck_ai_quota_indexes.py, test_tscheck_appraise_endpoint.py, and test_tscheck_appraise_robustness_and_gating.py throw 'RuntimeError: Event loop is closed' only when the full suite runs under pytest-xdist in parallel with real-Gemini-calling tests; test_tscheck_ai_quota_indexes.py and test_tscheck_shops_seeded_data.py pass individually. Unrelated to the thumbnail/list-performance fix under test.

checks.criterion: GET /inventory (list) no longer ships the full item_image/label_image/extra_images payload; it carries a small generated thumb_image instead
checks.name: test_tscheck_inventory_list_excludes_full_image
checks.evidence: POST /api/inventory 201 with an 800x800 JPEG; GET /api/inventory 200 -> created row has item_image=None, label_image=None, extra_images=[], thumb_image starts with 'data:image/jpeg;base64,' and is <1/4 the char-length of the full image. Fixture deleted via DELETE /api/inventory/{id}.

checks.criterion: POST /inventory auto-generates a 160px-long-edge JPEG thumb_image at upload; GET /inventory/{id} (detail) still returns the full-resolution item_image unchanged
checks.name: test_tscheck_inventory_create_generates_thumb
checks.evidence: POST /api/inventory 201, response.thumb_image present, != full image, decodes to a Pillow image with max(size)<=160. GET /api/inventory/{id} 200 -> item_image equals the original data URL byte-for-byte, thumb_image matches the create response. Fixture deleted.

checks.criterion: Inventory grid card renders the server-generated thumb_image (not the full item_image) for each row
checks.name: inventory-grid-uses-generated-thumbnail
checks.evidence: Created a tscheck-* fixture via POST /api/inventory (authenticated, CSRF header from sessionStorage), opened /inventory, card img src matched response.thumb_image exactly. Fixture deleted via DELETE afterward.

checks.criterion: Image lightbox (enlarge icon) fetches and displays the full-resolution item_image via GET /inventory/{id}, not just the list thumbnail
checks.name: inventory-lightbox-loads-full-resolution-image
checks.evidence: Clicked enlarge-{id} on a tscheck-* fixture card; captured GET /api/inventory/{id} response (200), body.item_image equals the originally-uploaded full image; lightbox dialog image rendered. Fixture deleted.

checks.criterion: Finds grid (public preview URL) also renders the thumb_image for search results
checks.name: finds-grid-uses-thumbnail-on-preview-url
checks.evidence: Run against https://thrift-vision.preview.emergentagent.com. Created tscheck-* fixture, searched for it on /finds, matched img[src^="data:image/jpeg"] equal to the create response's thumb_image. Fixture deleted.

cleanup: All 5 fixture items created by these checks (prefix tscheck-) were deleted by each check/test's own finally/cleanup block via DELETE /api/inventory/{id}. No seeded rows were touched.
